notes.subject: בני שחץ
notes.rationale: 'sons of pride' — KJV/Geneva read 'lion's whelps' (taking שחץ by a root akin to שחל lion), JPS/ASV 'proud beasts'; Bambara keeps the literal 'bonya-denw' (sons of pride).

notes.subject: שחץ / שחל
notes.rationale: Near-identical consonant pairs שחץ and שחל open the two halves — a sound-echo of the two untrodden-by-beasts lines, lost in Bambara.

notes.subject: o sirakan
notes.rationale: Even the proudest beasts have never walked this hidden path — continuation of the concealed-way motif.

translation: Bonya-denw t'u bolo sigi o sirakan, waraba t'a taara jugu a kan.
